title: Comicraft website
lede: The comic-lettering foundry’s home page opens on a full-width comic panel with halftone shading, a speech balloon, and a sunburst background.
summary: A comic panel hero with visible halftone dots, black ink lines, a speech balloon, and a yellow navigation bar.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. Nothing covers the page. The hero is a slideshow; the capture shows one slide.

styles.note: Clear example: halftone dot shading, heavy black ink lines, a speech balloon with lettering, a sunburst, and yellow and red. The panel is a contemporary comic drawing, not a Lichtenstein pastiche, and the palette leans orange rather than blue.

context: The site sells comic-book fonts; its navigation lists Word Balloons, Sound Effects, Character Voices, and Display Fonts. [Comicraft](https://www.comicbookfonts.com/).
observed: A bright yellow navigation bar holds the logo “The World’s Greatest Comic Book Fonts!” in red and yellow outlined letters, and menu items in a condensed comic font.
The hero is one comic panel: a hippo in a shirt and tie beside a woman on a sofa, drawn with black ink lines.
The figures are shaded with visible halftone dots in orange, red, and green.
A large white speech balloon with a black outline reads “Thru Thick and Thin?” in hand-lettered type.
Behind the panel, an orange sunburst of rays and paint splashes fills the width of the page.
A boxed “#5 2026” issue badge and an “Approved by the Comicraft Authority” seal copy comic-cover devices.
Below the hero, two flat yellow buttons read “WHAT’S NEW” and “MOST POPULAR” in black italic capitals.
interpretation: The halftone dots and heavy outlines are inside the hero image, so the extractor cannot see them: `surface.patternShare` is 0.06, `color.patternShare` is 0, and the median CSS border is 1 px. The page is a clear example by the rubric but fails those metrics for that reason.
Shadows cover 14% of boxes but with a 1 px offset and 1 px blur; they are not the hard offset shadows of neo-brutalism.
borrow: Put the main statement in a speech balloon over the hero image, not in a separate heading.
Use comic-cover furniture, such as an issue number box or a seal, as small secondary badges.

images.alt: Comicraft home page: a yellow navigation bar over a comic panel of a hippo in a shirt and tie and a woman on a sofa, shaded with halftone dots, with a large speech balloon reading Thru Thick and Thin? on an orange sunburst background.
